readme.run: Classify a dermoscopic lesion image across the 7 HAM10000 classes
notes: Input is a JPEG or PNG dermoscopic photograph.
Pass --color-constancy for Shades of Gray (p=6) normalization before 224x224 resize.
Pass --saliency to also compute a 5x5 occlusion sensitivity PNG overlay.
Add --help for every option: thread count, cache directory, offline mode and overwrite.
The quantized HAM10000 ViT-Base ONNX model is bundled and verified by SHA-256; no network is required.
Research and educational use only — uncalibrated softmax scores are not a medical device or clinical diagnosis.
